name: Fes
blurb: Conversation about Fes is up 234% on its six-month baseline, driven by travellers describing it as a calmer alternative to nearby hotspots. Most posts mention beaches, value and the shoulder season.

positive: Easy to get around without a car
Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
Good value compared with last year
negative: Prices noticeably up on last season

quotes.text: Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
Spent a week here working remotely, wifi was fine everywhere.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
